preamble: Denasalization of a mid front nasal vowel to oral open-mid [ɛ]. The documented cases involve an open-mid nasal [ɛ̃] rather than close-mid [ẽ]; because the atlas has no separate ɛ̃ symbol, they are recorded here. Proto-Slavic *ę [ɛ̃ː] lost its nasality in Bulgarian and Macedonian, giving [ɛ], and Polish ę is denasalized word-finally and before /l/ and /w/.

examples.from: będę 'I will be' with final ę
examples.note: Word-final ę is pronounced as oral [ɛ]; before /l/ and /w/ nasality is lost altogether.
The front nasal vowel *ę denasalized to [ɛ]; dialectal пен preserves a trace of the nasal.
Same denasalization of *ę as in Bulgarian.
